messages.subject: Controlling legend color and linetypes
parts:
Hello ggplot2 experts,
 
I want to create a legend that has the symbols controlled for color and line type. What I get is two legends one controlled for colors and one for linetypes. How do I combine the instructions to produce one legend? Also is there a way to make the ploting symbols in the legend thicker i.e. control the size.
 
 
Thank you for your comments.
 
Here is the code:
 
require(colorspace)
require(ggplot2)
require(reshape2)
cbbPalette <- c("#000000", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")
cbbPalette2<-brewer.pal(8,"Dark2")
 
f <- data.frame(time = 1:10,
                 a = cumsum(rnorm(10)),
                 b = cumsum(rnorm(10)),
                 c = cumsum(rnorm(10)),
                 d = cumsum(rnorm(10)),
                 e = cumsum(rnorm(10)))
                                 
df <- melt(df ,  id = "time")
 
p<-ggplot(df, aes(time,value,colour=variable,linetype=variable)) + geom_line()
 
p<-p+scale_linetype_manual(name="",labels = c("A", "B", C", "D", "E","F","G"),values =c(1:7))
 
p<-p+scale_colour_manual(name="",labels = c("A", "B", C", "D", "E","F","G"),values =c(cbbPalette[c(1:4,6)], cbbPalette2[7],cbbPalette[8]) )
 
p<-p+theme(legend.position = "top")+guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2))
 
print(p)

On Mon, Feb 18, 2013 at 1:25 PM, David Guy
<rstatistica...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello ggplot2 experts,
>
> I want to create a legend that has the symbols controlled for color and line
> type. What I get is two legends one controlled for colors and one for
> linetypes. How do I combine the instructions to produce one legend?

They will be merged by default. You've forced them to be separate by
giving them different orders e.g., guide_legend(order = 1)

Also is
> there a way to make the ploting symbols in the legend thicker i.e. control
> the size.

use override.aes, e.g.,

p + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=1),
linetype=list(size=1)))

Best,
Ista
